commands.author: hugenshen

target.title: fix(browser): do not sticky-adopt policy-blocked openTab targets
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`openTab` could sticky-adopt a tab whose **final** URL failed browser SSRF policy. Chrome MCP and CDP create-target paths set `runtime.lastTargetId` before `assertBrowserNavigationResultAllowed`. When an allowed request URL redirected to a private endpoint (for example `http://127.0.0.1/...`), `openTab` still rejected — but the blocked target stayed sticky for the next targetless browser action.

## Why This Change Was Made

Align Chrome MCP and CDP create-target adoption with the existing raw `/json/new` contract already documented in the same file: adopt `lastTargetId` only after post-navigation policy passes. Playwright `createPageViaPlaywright` already validates before returning, so it needed no change.

## User Impact

**Before:** A rejected redirect open could still become the implicit target for later snapshot/act calls that omit `targetId`.

**After:** Policy-blocked final URLs do not update `lastTargetId`; the next targetless action keeps the previous sticky target and cannot land on the blocked tab via sticky selection.

## Evidence

- Changed: `extensions/browser/src/browser/server-context.tab-ops.ts` (Chrome MCP + CDP create-target sticky adoption)
- Sibling contract already present on raw `/json/new`: "Adopt only fully validated targets..."
- Regressions:
  - `extensions/browser/src/browser/server-context.existing-session.test.ts` (Chrome MCP + next targetless `ensureTabAvailable`)
  - `extensions/browser/src/browser/server-context.tab-selection-state.test.ts` (CDP create-target + next targetless `ensureTabAvailable`)
  - `extensions/browser/src/browser/server-context.tab-ops.sticky-blocked.live.test.ts` (live Chrome CDP; skips unless live env is set)

### Unit regression

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/browser/src/browser/server-context.existing-session.test.ts extensions/browser/src/browser/server-context.tab-selection-state.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

```text
 ✓ |extension-browser| ... > does not sticky-adopt a CDP-created tab when the discovered URL is policy-blocked 3ms
 ✓ |extension-browser| ... > does not sticky-adopt a Chrome MCP tab when the final URL is policy-blocked 1ms
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  28 passed (28)
[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 4.46s
```

### Live Chrome/CDP proof

```bash
OPENCLAW_LIVE_TEST=1 OPENCLAW_LIVE_BROWSER_STICKY_PROOF=1 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs --config test/vitest/vitest.live.config.ts extensions/browser/src/browser/server-context.tab-ops.sticky-blocked.live.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

```text
{
  "proof": "live-chrome-cdp-sticky-blocked-openTab",
  "chrome": "Google Chrome headless CDP",
  "redirectRequestHost": "LAN IPv4 (allowlisted)",
  "finalUrlHost": "127.0.0.1",
  "openTabRejected": true,
  "stickyAfterReject": "unchanged-good-target",
  "targetlessEnsureTabAvailable": "selected-good-target-not-blocked",
  "goodTargetIdPrefix": "737E4DAB",
  "blockedTargetIdPrefix": "2226662A",
  "selectedTargetIdPrefix": "737E4DAB",
  "sameStickyTarget": true
}
 ✓ ... > rejects a LAN→loopback redirect and keeps the previous sticky target 1135ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  1 passed (1)
```

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior or issue addressed:** Blocked post-navigation `openTab` results no longer sticky-adopt `lastTargetId` on Chrome MCP or CDP create-target paths; the next targetless `ensureTabAvailable()` keeps the previous good sticky target.
- **Canonical reachability path:** Browser tool / control routes → profile `openTab` → Chrome MCP `openChromeMcpTab` or CDP `createTargetViaCdp` + `/json/list` discovery → `assertBrowserNavigationResultAllowed` → only then `runtime.lastTargetId = …` → later targetless `ensureTabAvailable()`.
- **Boundary crossed:** External/redirected page URL → local sticky target selection used by targetless browser actions.
- **Shared helper / provider constraint check:** Reuses existing `assertBrowserNavigationResultAllowed`; matches raw `/json/new` adopt-after-validate ordering. Does not add config/env.
- **Real environment tested:** macOS + Google Chrome headless CDP; LAN HTTP 302 redirector allowlisted only for the request host; final hop `http://127.0.0.1:9/` blocked by default private-network SSRF policy. Production `openTab` discovery/validation/sticky path exercised against the live blocked target, then targetless `ensureTabAvailable()`.
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch:**

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/browser/src/browser/server-context.existing-session.test.ts extensions/browser/src/browser/server-context.tab-selection-state.test.ts --reporter=verbose
OPENCLAW_LIVE_TEST=1 OPENCLAW_LIVE_BROWSER_STICKY_PROOF=1 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs --config test/vitest/vitest.live.config.ts extensions/browser/src/browser/server-context.tab-ops.sticky-blocked.live.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

- **Evidence after fix:**

```text
Unit:
 ✓ ... > does not sticky-adopt a CDP-created tab when the discovered URL is policy-blocked
 ✓ ... > does not sticky-adopt a Chrome MCP tab when the final URL is policy-blocked
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  28 passed (28)

Live Chrome CDP:
{
  "openTabRejected": true,
  "stickyAfterReject": "unchanged-good-target",
  "targetlessEnsureTabAvailable": "selected-good-target-not-blocked",
  "goodTargetIdPrefix": "737E4DAB",
  "blockedTargetIdPrefix": "2226662A",
  "selectedTargetIdPrefix": "737E4DAB",
  "sameStickyTarget": true
}
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  1 passed (1)
```

- **Observed result after fix:** Both mocked paths and live Chrome reject the blocked final URL, leave sticky on the previous good target (not the blocked id), and the next targetless `ensureTabAvailable()` selects that good target.
- **What was not tested:** Closing the orphaned blocked tab after rejection; remote CDP Playwright path (already validates inside `createPageViaPlaywright`); Chrome MCP live driver (covered by mocked production-path regression).
- **Fix classification:** Root cause fix

- [x] AI-assisted (Cursor)
- [x] I understand what the code does
- [x] Change is focused and does not mix unrelated concerns
